about: The JavaScript size ratchet of the editor build (scripts/js-budget.mjs). Per entry page, the bytes of every script its HTML names (the entry script and its modulepreloads), raw and gzip, as measured from a production build. A build more than `tolerance` over a number fails: raise it here, in the change that grows the entry, and say why in the commit. `bun scripts/js-budget.mjs --write` records the current build.
